question: How can the mind cross over while immersed in objects?
premises: The self may be sinking in the ocean of difference.
Even then, this mind can carry the self across.
This occurs even while the mind is in an object-bound taste.
inference: The mind, rightly oriented, can rescue the self from difference even amid sensory immersion.
plain_english: Thus this mind carries the self across from the ocean of difference, even when it is sinking while still in the taste of objects.
